Their record as we recorded it since July 2026, graded by us at the line and price we saw. It can differ from records they publish. $10 a pick. 4 more cappers we track have not qualified in NFL yet.
designs.rationale: Same ledger direction, same three-line row (identity, metrics, sub line), same ticket stub. Changes are only what the round-3 critic asked for. (1) The (i) glyph now inherits the system stack (font-family: inherit, upright, 700) instead of Georgia italic. (2) Every selector now starts with ".v13 " including the root rule, which moved onto an inner .v13-wrap so nothing is written as a bare ".v13 {". (3) Wrap risks: the stub is a fixed 104px column (128px at 560px+) and the disc dropped to 28px, so the text column has about 222px at 390px; the identity line (longest is KnightDasCapital + Polymarket, roughly 195px) now fits on one line. The streak chip moved from the metrics line to the sub line next to "Recorded", which keeps record/money/ROI on one line for every row and keeps "Recorded 21h before start + NFL L5" under about 200px; the Small sample chip shrank to 9.5px with tighter padding and the sub line is 10.5px so HomeRunHazard's line fits with margin. (4) Uneven row heights: the "no price, graded at -110" text now breaks explicitly after the comma (two nowrap lines, never three) and every price block has a 24px min-height, so every stub is the same height and every row is uniform at about 83px, priced or not. Total html+css sits a little under the previous size thanks to the fixed-width stub and the trimmed selectors.
designs.free_tier_notes: Free tier sees the same list. Names, metrics, the source badge and the pick chip stay visible; the profile tap and the Bet stub route into the existing paywall flow when the user is not paying. Nothing in the fragment reveals the scoring engine or the source pipeline beyond the sanctioned source badge names.
designs.graded_state_notes: Once the game goes final the same rows stay in place; the count line already says the list freezes at kickoff. A graded result would ride the stub (a W/L/Push mark replacing the Bet label) and the tint on the price line, with the metrics line unchanged since it is the NFL record as of the recording time. The count strip counts do not change after kickoff.

issues: Nit (cosmetic, not a contract break): the (i) summary glyph uses Georgia / Times serif italic instead of the system font stack. Swap to the inherited stack (or a plain 'i' in the system font) to stay fully inside the 'system font stack' rule.
Nit: the root rule is written as '.v13 {' (no trailing space) rather than '.v13 ' prefix; it is still scoped to the fragment root, so no leakage risk.
Nit: total html+css is roughly 14 KB, under the 16 KB cap but close; nothing to trim required.
layout_risks: At 390px the identity line has ~200px available; 'OldSchool0909 + Action Network' and 'KnightDasCapital + Polymarket' will likely push the source badge to a second line (wrap, not clip). Rows with a streak chip (OldSchool0909, stevet81) wrap the metrics line to two lines. Both are graceful wraps.
HomeRunHazard's sub line ('Recorded 4h before start' + 'Small sample' chip) is borderline and may wrap the chip onto its own line.

The bet stub for 'no price, graded at -110' rows becomes two-line price text inside a 92-124px stub, making those three rows ~90px tall versus ~76px for priced rows; still readable, just uneven row heights.
critique.design_notes: Checks: (a) every selector is scoped under .v13, root div is 'v v13 bleed-root', no style/script. (b) Only token vars plus rgba tints derived from --accent (59,130,246) and --green (34,197,94); no foreign hex. (c) All nine pick chips carry pk + the correct side class (chi/dal/chi/over/dal/chi/under/dal/over matching the fixture); all nine badges carry src + the correct source class (an/pm/cm/pm/an/an/cv/cv/cv); streaks are 'stk stk-w' 'NFL W5' on OldSchool0909 and 'stk stk-l' 'NFL L5' on stevet81 only; the CSS sets no color/background/border-color on any .pk-* or .src-* selector (neutral base on .pk and .src only). (d) Copy is limited to the title, '9 cappers, freezes at kickoff', the five pills, row content, 'Show all 9' / 'Show fewer', 'Bet' captions, and the (i) details whose text matches the required string verbatim; no humility line, grading note, six-slot grid, or hint sentence. (e) No forbidden words, no em dashes (aria-label 'NFL profile' contains 'pro' only as a substring of 'profile'). (f) All nine cappers present with name, badge, record, money, ROI, pick, price, recorded time; sorted by money descending; Small sample chip on HomeRunHazard; five shown by default with a working no-JS 'Show all 9' checkbox (sibling order inputs -> head -> strip -> list -> more is correct for the ~ combinators). (g) No text-overflow: ellipsis anywhere; names use overflow-wrap: anywhere; metrics and sub lines flex-wrap; the only nowrap items (pk chip, src badge, pills) fit their widest fixture strings ('Under 44.5' ~86px in a 100px content box, 'Under 1' in ~67px pills), and .v13-list's overflow:hidden never clips them because nothing exceeds the row. (h) Estimated ~620px collapsed (head 55 + strip 38 + five rows ~430 + Show all 37 + foot 36), ~990px expanded, within bounds thanks to the collapse control. (i) List runs full width with only top/bottom borders; the count strip has 8px side margin; text blocks have 14px inner padding. (j) Two clear targets per row: the name/disc link with a chevron after the name and accent hover, and the ticket-edged stub with perforation, notch circles, and an uppercase 'Bet' caption with chevron.

designs.rationale: Same direction as before: an edge-to-edge ledger where every row is two visibly separate zones. The left zone (side rail, initials disc, PROFILE caption, name, source badge, record / money / ROI line, recorded time) is one link to the capper's NFL profile; the right zone (tinted, bordered, with the pick chip, price, and a BET chevron label) is one link to the bet sheet. The count strip is a five-pill no-JS radio filter. Fixes this round, all cosmetic: the root rule is now `.v14.v` so a strict prefix scan passes; the (i) glyph inherits the system stack and gets its italic from font-style; the streak badge moved from top 21px to 24px so it sits under the initials rather than across their lower third. Nothing else changed.
designs.free_tier_notes: Free users see the same section in full: names, records, money, ROI, picks and prices are all visible, since this is the capper database, not the pick ranking. Both tap targets stay live; the profile link opens the capper's NFL tab and the Bet link opens the bet sheet for that slot. No paywall inside this fragment.
designs.graded_state_notes: After kickoff the count line changes to "9 cappers, frozen at kickoff" and the Bet zone loses its link (the chip and price stay, the BET label drops, the tint goes neutral). Once graded, each row's pick chip can carry the host's win/loss/push tint and the metrics line updates to the post-game NFL record and money. No new copy is added; the filter strip and (i) note are unchanged.

issues: Minor, not a violation: the root rule is written as `.v14 {` (no trailing space). It scopes correctly, but a strict automated prefix check for '.v14 ' would trip on it; `.v14.v {` or `.v.v14 {` would satisfy both.

Minor: the (i) glyph uses a Georgia/Times serif stack for the italic i. The rules say system font stack; harmless visually but technically off the stack. Could use the system stack with font-style italic instead.

Minor: the streak badge (absolute, right:-7px, top:21px, ~55px wide on a 44px avatar column) overlaps the bottom third of the 30px disc and extends ~4px left of the avatar box. Initials stay legible (font centered above the overlap) and nothing is clipped, but it is tight; top:24px would clear the initials more cleanly.
layout_risks: At 390px the bet column is 138px (118px content). 'Under 44.5' bold 13.5px nowrap is ~100px wide so it fits; .pk has no overflow hidden so a wider chip would spill visibly rather than clip.

Left column content width is ~179px after rail padding, avatar and gap. 'KnightDasCapital' + 'Polymarket' badge is right at the wrap point (~176px); it may wrap the badge to a second line, adding ~13px to that row. Not a defect, just row height variance.
HomeRunHazard sub line ('Recorded 4h before start' + Small sample chip) exceeds 179px and wraps the chip to a second line (+16px). Fine, handled by flex-wrap.
Streak badge overlaps the disc (see issues); no clipping, cosmetic only.
critique.design_notes: Checks: (a) all rules scoped under .v14 (root rule is `.v14 {` itself, see minor issue); root div has 'v v14 bleed-root'; no style/script. (b) only token vars plus rgba tints of --accent (59,130,246) and --green (34,197,94); side rails use --team-away/--team-home/--over/--under directly, which is allowed. (c) all nine .pk chips carry the correct pk-dal/pk-chi/pk-over/pk-under per side; all badges carry the correct src-an/src-pm/src-cv/src-cm; .pk and .src have neutral surface2/border/muted or text bases; no color, background or border-color is set on any .pk-* or .src-* selector; streak chips are 'stk stk-w' (NFL W5 + flame) on OldSchool0909 and 'stk stk-l' (NFL L5 + snowflake) on stevet81 only. (d) visible copy is limited to the title, '9 cappers, freezes at kickoff', the five pills (All 9 / DAL 3 / CHI 3 / Over 2 / Under 1), row content, 'Profile' and 'Bet' captions, and the closed <details> (i) whose paragraph matches the required text exactly; no humility line, grading note, six-slot grid or hint sentence. (e) no forbidden words, no em dashes (aria-labels and class names only, not visible). (f) nine rows in NFL money descending order, each with name, badge, record, money (green/red), ROI with the word ROI, 'Recorded Nh before start', pick chip, price; Small sample chip on HomeRunHazard only. (g) no text-overflow: ellipsis and no overflow:hidden anywhere; the only nowrap elements (.pk, .stk, .src, pills, price at >=560px) have room or spill visibly; names use overflow-wrap: anywhere; the price wraps at phone width. (h) head ~55 + strip ~40 + list margin 8 + rows (six ~66, three with two-line 'no price, graded at -110' ~75, plus wraps on KnightDasCapital badge and HomeRunHazard chip) ~650 + foot ~30 = ~790px, under 850 with all nine shown, so no collapse control needed. (i) strip has 8px side margins, list is full bleed, text blocks carry 14px inner padding. (j) two clear targets per row: the profile <a> spans disc + name + metrics with a 'PROFILE' caption under the disc, and the bet <a> is a visually separate right column (border-left, faint accent tint) holding the chip, price and a 'BET >' caption. Clean pass.

i

Their record as we recorded it since July 2026, graded by us at the line and price we saw. It can differ from records they publish. $10 a pick. 4 more cappers we track have not qualified in NFL yet.
designs.rationale: Same direction as before: a side-colored slip rail on top for the fast Bet path, then the five-pill filter strip, then the ledger list with the name/disc area (underlined name + chevron) opening the profile and the ticket-edged slip (dashed perforation + "Bet" caption) opening the bet sheet. Revisions: (1) size trimmed to 7,671 B css + 8,102 B html = 15,773 B by dropping the scroll-snap rules and the four :hover states (focus-visible states kept for keyboard users). (2) The (i) summary now inherits the system font stack (12px/700, no serif, no italic). Layout risks also addressed without changing the design: ledger slip widened to min 96 / max 116px and the .pk chip padding tightened to 7px, so "Under 44.5" has roughly 14px of spare room even on wider system fonts; the rail now uses align-items:flex-start so single-line cards no longer stretch to the tallest card and the "Bet" caption sits directly under the money line on every card. The three-line "no price, graded at -110" rows (7-9) still run taller than rows 1-6; that is the price text itself, which the rules require verbatim, and it only appears in the expanded tail.
designs.free_tier_notes: Everything in the fragment renders for free users: rail, filter strip, five ledger rows with Show all 9, the (i) details. Both tap targets stay live; the host decides whether the profile route or the bet sheet gates behind sign-in, and no upsell copy lives inside the section.
designs.graded_state_notes: After kickoff the count line reads the frozen state; the host can swap the "Bet" captions for a result mark on each slip (W/L/P) and the row-level side edge stays. No pick chip or metrics line changes shape, so graded rows keep the same height. The rail can be hidden post-game since it exists only for the fast bet path.

issues: Size is tight: css 7,925 B + html 8,102 B = 16,027 B. Under 16,384 (16 KiB) but over 16,000 if the harness counts KB as 1000. Trim (drop scroll-snap rules or the :hover states) to get clear margin.
The (i) summary uses font: italic 700 12px/1 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif for the single 'i' glyph. Rules say system font stack. Cosmetic, but a literal deviation.
layout_risks: Ledger slip (.st) max-width 106px: 'Under 44.5' pk chip at 12.5px bold is ~81px + 2px border, and the slip's inner box is ~104px after 13+6 padding and borders. It fits, but only by a few px on wider system fonts; a 2px overrun would overlap the ticket's rounded right edge (no clipping, just overlap).
Rows 7-9 (three-line 'no price, graded at -110' in the slip) grow to ~107px, so row heights are uneven between the top five and the expanded tail.

The 'Bet' caption sits at the bottom of every rail card via margin-top:auto; because .rl uses align-items:stretch and three cards carry a two-line price, all nine rail cards stretch to ~130px, leaving a small blank band inside the six single-line cards.
critique.design_notes: Checks: (a) every selector is under .v15 (the root rule is '.v15{' itself, which is scoped); root div has 'v v15 bleed-root'; no style/script. (b) Colors: only tokens plus rgba tints of green (34,197,94), accent (59,130,246) and muted (136,146,164); side vars used only on row/rail left edges. (c) Contract clean: all 18 pk chips (rail + ledger) carry the right pk-dal/chi/over/under per fixture side; all 9 src badges map correctly (AN=src-an, PM=src-pm, Community=src-cm, Covers=src-cv); streak chips 'stk stk-w' NFL W5 on OldSchool0909 and 'stk stk-l' NFL L5 on stevet81 only; no color/background/border-color on any .pk-* or .src-* selector. (d) Copy is only the title, count line, five pills, row content, Bet captions, Show all 9 / Show fewer, and the exact (i) text; no humility line, grading note, six-slot grid or hints. (e) No forbidden words (grep clean), no em dashes. (f) All nine cappers in the ledger with name, badge, record, money, ROI, pick, price, recorded time; Small sample chip on HomeRunHazard; sort order matches money desc. Default shows five rows plus a visible 'Show all 9' label (nth-child(n+6) hidden while f-all checked and x unchecked). (g) No text-overflow ellipsis and no overflow:hidden anywhere; names use overflow-wrap:anywhere, pk nowrap but chips have room, prices wrap (white-space:normal). (h) Height at 390px: header ~55 + rail ~136 + pills ~43 + list gap 8 + five rows ~420 + Show all ~38 + (i) ~32 = ~735px collapsed; ~1,140px expanded behind the control. (i) Edge to edge: rail and pill strip have 8px side margin, ledger rows are full-bleed, slip has 8px right margin. (j) Two tap targets per row: name is underlined with a chevron (profile), slip has a ticket perforation edge plus an uppercase accent 'Bet' with chevron (bet sheet); rail cards are Bet-labeled slips. The rail is the variant's named direction so it is not an unsanctioned element above the list. Also verified the no-JS selectors: radios and the .x checkbox precede .rl/.sf/.ls/.mr as siblings, so the sibling combinators resolve.

designs.rationale: Same two-line ledger: name row (disc, name with chevron, source badge, streak or small-sample chip) on top, bet slip box and money line underneath, side tint on the left edge, dashed rules between cappers. Fixes this round: (1) the price text is split into two nowrap segments ("no price," / "graded at -110") with max-width 96px, so the three unpriced rows wrap into exactly two lines that match the chip height, restoring even row rhythm; (2) the bet/metrics line and the numbers cluster are flex-wrap wrap with nowrap on each atom, so under host font scaling the metrics drop below the slip box instead of visually overflowing the slip border; (3) the profile chevron is now 8px, 2px stroke, accent blue at full opacity, and the ticket edge is accent blue and slightly larger, so the two tap targets read on a dark surface without extra copy; (4) all root styles moved onto an inner .v16-in wrapper so every selector begins with ".v16 " literally.
designs.free_tier_notes: Free tier renders the identical section. No copy or rows are hidden; the bet slip box still opens the bet sheet and the profile link still opens the capper profile on the NFL tab. No paywall states are introduced here.
designs.graded_state_notes: Once the game grades, the count line and strip stay as recorded (freezes at kickoff). Each row would carry the result on the slip box (a win/loss/push mark next to the ticket edge) and the money line could show the settled delta; the layout already reserves the wrap-safe space for a short result token since the bet line wraps gracefully.

layout_risks: .v16-price max-width 84px forces the three 'no price, graded at -110' rows to wrap into three lines at 10.5px (about 36px tall), so those bet targets are visibly taller than the six 'at -1xx' rows; not a rule break, just uneven row rhythm.

.v16-l2 pairs a shrinkable .v16-bet (flex 0 1 auto) with a nowrap .v16-met (flex 0 0 auto). At 390px the widest combination (Under 44.5 wrapped price + '58-61 -$86 -3.6% ROI') measures roughly 350px of 362px available, so it fits, but there is only ~10px of slack; any host font scaling above 100% would push the pk chip to visually overflow its own border (no clipping, since nothing sets overflow hidden).

Tap-target markers are small: the profile chevron is 6x6px at .75 opacity and the ticket edge is 16x11px. They satisfy the 'chevron after the name' and 'ticket edge' options, but they are subtle on a dark surface; the bordered .v16-bet box does most of the work of signalling the second target.
The root selector is written '.v16 {' (no trailing space) for the container's own styles; every other selector begins with '.v16 '. Scoped correctly, noted only for strictness.
critique.design_notes: Checks: (a) all selectors scoped to .v16, root has 'v v16 bleed-root', no style/script. (b) only token vars plus rgba tints of --accent and --green. (c) all nine pk chips carry the correct pk-dal/chi/over/under; all badges carry the correct src-an/pm/cv/cm; 'stk stk-w' NFL W5 on OldSchool0909 and 'stk stk-l' NFL L5 on stevet81 only; no color/background/border-color on any .pk-* or .src-* selector (color on .stk-w/.stk-l is allowed). (d) copy limited to title, count line, five pills, row content and the (i) details with the exact required paragraph; no humility line, grading note, grid or hints (Profile/bet wording lives only in aria-labels). (e) no forbidden words, no em dashes. (f) nine rows sorted +212 down to -140, each with name, badge, record, money (green/red), ROI, pick chip, price, 'Recorded Nh before start'; Small sample chip on HomeRunHazard. (g) no text-overflow ellipsis and no overflow hidden anywhere; names use overflow-wrap anywhere, prices wrap inside 84px. (h) head ~54 + strip ~32 + list margin ~11 + six rows ~73 + three wrapped-price rows ~85 + info ~30 = ~820px at 390px, under 850 with no collapse needed. (i) strip has 8px side margin, list runs edge to edge with 14px inner padding. (j) two targets per row: profile link (disc + name + chevron, row-wide hover) and the bordered bet box with ticket edge. Total html + css estimated ~14KB, under 16KB.

designs.rationale: Same direction as before: a flat, edge-to-edge ledger where each row carries a 4px side edge in the side color, a segmented filter strip above the list, and a divided Bet column on the right so the two tap targets read as two distinct surfaces. Revision changes only: (1) size cut from 17,483 to 15,368 bytes (css 7,765 + html 7,603) by moving both chevrons to ::after pseudo-elements instead of nine pairs of inline <i> tags, dropping the redundant .v17-when wrapper, shortening the bet-link aria-labels to "Open bet" (the chip and price text are already read by screen readers), merging duplicate hover/active/focus/display:none rules, and removing transitions and tap-highlight declarations that added bytes without changing the look. (2) The (i) summary now inherits the system font stack; the Georgia italic is gone. (3) Layout-risk fix: Bet column widened 112 to 118px and chip padding trimmed to 5px 7px so "Under 44.5" sits on one line at 390px. Nothing else moved.
designs.free_tier_notes: Free users see the same list. The name link opens the capper profile on the NFL tab; the Bet column opens the bet sheet. No content is hidden behind the paywall in this section; the host may gate the bet sheet itself.
designs.graded_state_notes: After kickoff the count line reads as frozen ("freezes at kickoff" already states it); the host can swap the "Bet" label for a result mark (W/L/P) in the same .v17-go slot and tint the pk chip via its color mode. Rows keep their side edge so a graded list still sorts visually by side. The five-row collapse and side filters keep working unchanged.

issues: SIZE: html + css measured at 17,483 bytes (css 8,622 + html 8,861), over the 16 KB cap by about 1.4 KB. Every other rule and contract check passes, so this is the only blocker.
The (i) summary uses a Georgia/Times serif italic 'i' glyph; the direction calls for the system font stack. Minor, but it is the one non-system font in the fragment.
layout_risks: Bet column is 112px wide with 6+14px padding and the .pk chip has 8+8px padding, leaving roughly 76px for chip text. 'Under 44.5' in 12.5px bold is near that width and will wrap to two lines ('Under' / '44.5'); not clipped, but the chip goes taller than its neighbours.
Metrics line on OldSchool0909 (record + streak chip + money + ROI) is wider than the ~219px main column at 390px, so it wraps to two lines; still fully visible.
Long names plus the source badge (KnightDasCapital + Polymarket, HomeRunHazard + Action Network) push the badge onto a second ident line; fine, just taller rows.
Profile tap target is marked only by a 6px chevron after the name; the Bet side has a text label plus divider, so the two are distinguishable, but the profile side is the quieter of the two.

The five-row collapse and the side filters interact correctly (radios and checkbox precede the list in DOM so the ~ combinators resolve), but a filtered view hides the Show all control by design; expected.
truncation_risks: None. No text-overflow: ellipsis, no overflow: hidden anywhere. white-space: nowrap appears only on badges, streak chips, the Small sample chip and the filter pills, all of which are short fixed labels. Names use overflow-wrap: anywhere, pick chips and prices are white-space: normal with max-width: 100%, the metrics line is flex-wrap: wrap.
contract_violations: Total size 17,483 bytes exceeds the 16 KB html + css limit.
critique.design_notes: Checks: (a) every CSS selector begins with '.v17 ' (the @media block nests only .v17-prefixed rules), root is 'v v17 bleed-root', no style/script. (b) Colors are all host tokens or rgba tints of accent/green; side tints on the row left edge use --team-away/--team-home/--over/--under, pills use the -ink variants. (c) All nine pick chips carry pk + the correct side class (CHI/DAL/Over/Under match the fixture), all badges carry src + the correct source class, streak chips are 'stk stk-w' / 'stk stk-l' with 'NFL W5' flame and 'NFL L5' snowflake on OldSchool0909 and stevet81 only, and the CSS sets no color, background or border-color on any .pk-* or .src-* selector. (d) Copy is limited to the title, the count line, five pills, row content, Show all 9 / Show fewer, the Bet caption and the (i) details whose text matches the required string exactly; no humility line, grading note, six-slot grid or hint sentence. (e) No forbidden words, no em dashes. (f) All nine cappers present with name, badge, record, money (green/red), ROI, pick, price, recorded time; Small sample chip on HomeRunHazard; sorted by money descending. (g) No truncation mechanisms. (h) Default view is five rows with a Show all 9 control: head ~55 + strip ~38 + gap 8 + five rows ~85 avg (~425) + Show all ~44 + foot ~32, about 610px; all nine expanded lands near 960px behind the control, which is allowed. (i) Strip and Show-all button sit at 8px side margins, the list itself is full bleed with top/bottom borders only, text blocks have 14px inner padding. (j) Two targets per row: the profile link (disc + name + chevron) and the Bet column (chip, price, 'Bet' with chevron) separated by a 1px divider; both have hover/active/focus states. Only failing item is the byte budget; trimming aria-labels (the picks and prices are already visible text), the hover/transition rules and the media query would bring it under 16 KB.
